content.text: In regions like Zimbabwe and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators struggle to sell their products online. With infrastructure sovereignty as the only viable solution, COREMERCH offers a bespoke, base-layer commerce stack that enables creators to own and control their entire digital store, from hosting to payment processing. This comprehensive infrastructure guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-every|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-guide-leaves-3|Everything About]]-you-need-6|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, leveraging Stack 01 or Stack 02, both of which are designed to overcome the limitations of traditional payment gateways.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key advantage of COREMERCH's infrastructure is its ability to withstand platform failures and restrictions. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, creators can ensure a seamless and secure payment experience, even in regions with severe platform restrictions. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but rather a base-layer solution that empowers creators to own and control their entire digital store.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you need to set up your NOWPayments account, which requires a one-time fee of $0.50 per transaction. Choose a recommended network for low fees, such as BSC, Solana, or TRON, and ensure that your wallet is properly connected to your NOWPayments account. Additionally, you will need to create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account and set up your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, deploy your Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, depending on your needs. Configure your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments with your chosen stack and configure automatic crypto payment verification. This step-by-step process will ensure a secure and seamless payment experience for your customers.
With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on Stripe or other conventional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, go live with your crypto store by configuring your SPF/DKIM/DMARC records and testing your nowpayments payment gateway on the main network. Process your first transaction by sending a test payment from your connected wallet. With the Edge Commerce Stack, this process can be done in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. This will ensure a successful and hassle-free deployment of your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your crypto store grows, you can scale your infrastructure with the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. You can also use the Sovereign Blueprint to upgrade your infrastructure and improve your payment and delivery pipeline. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can scale your digital store without worrying about platform restrictions or failures.
